newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 23.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Finance Minister Jean Arthuis under criticism from members of the majority for his management of the Credit Foncier crisis.
-- Defence Minister Charles Millon hints that a public offering may be favoured for the sale of a 58-percent stake held by the state in defence electronics group Thomson-CSF.
-- Deutsche Telekom executive Ron Sommer says in an interview that partnership with Frence Telecom is central to the German operator's globalisation strategy.
-- Asia to become top target for multinational groups who seek increasing foreign operations, survey shows.
-- Welfare debt repayment fund CADES named "1996 issuer of the year" on international capital markets, by a British magazine.
